### 变更类型 / Type of Change

<!-- 勾选适用项 [x] / Check all that apply -->

- [ ] 🐛 Bug 修复 / Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ 新功能 / New feature
- [ ] 📚 文档更新 / Documentation
- [ ] ♻️ 代码重构（不改变外部行为）/ Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] 🧪 测试 / Tests
- [ ] 🔧 构建 / CI / 工程化 / Build, CI or tooling

### 变更内容概述 / Summary

<!-- 简要说明本 PR 做了什么 / Brief description of the changes -->

### 关联 Issue / Related Issue

<!-- 如修复某个 Issue，请写 Fixes #123 / Fixes #123 if applicable -->

### 验证方式 / Checklist

- [ ] 我已在本地运行 `npm run typecheck` / Ran `npm run typecheck` locally
- [ ] 我已在本地运行 `npm run lint` / Ran `npm run lint` locally
- [ ] 我已在本地运行 `npm run test` / Ran `npm run test` locally
- [ ] 我已在本地运行 `npm run build` 确认构建通过 / `npm run build` passes
- [ ] 如有 UI 变更，已手动验证界面表现与交互 / UI changes manually verified

### 其他说明 / Additional Notes

<!-- 文档更新 / 破坏性变更 / 截图等 / Docs, breaking changes, screenshots, etc. -->
